notes.observation: 96→97 joins 'மீதம் ஐந்து ரூபாயை என்னை / அண்டி வந்த அருமை மனைவிக்கு'.
The narrator is chased, badge-grabbed, beaten in a conspirators' liquor-filled house, left unconscious by a gutter, then cared for by an unknown family.
notes.translation_action: Preserve physical sequence, quoted maternal compassion and later gratitude without sensational addition.

notes.observation: Helpers send him out disguised in source-described Muslim dress: கைலி, long jippa and skullcap/kullai.
notes.translation_action: Translate clothing concretely and neutrally; do not invent stereotyped mannerisms or identity claims beyond the source.

notes.observation: Periyar embraces him, treats his wounds, takes him to Erode and appoints him Kudi Arasu assistant editor; salary arithmetic is 40 rupees less 20 food, 10 snacks, 5 other expenses, leaving 5 sent to Padma.
notes.translation_action: Preserve affection, employment transition and exact household economy.

notes.observation: Daily bathing/clean clothes are jokingly treated by colleagues and Periyar as almost anti-Periyar habits, producing the title question.
notes.translation_action: Preserve affectionate/deadpan humour; do not turn it into doctrinal conflict.

notes.observation: Kudi Arasu office routine includes nominal editor Karivaradasamy and articles 'அண்ணாமலைக்கு அரோகரா!' and 'தீட்டாயிடுத்து!', the latter responding to ritual purification after a Tamil song at the Thyagaraja festival.
notes.translation_action: Keep article titles, legal-risk joke, Tamil-language grievance and source chronology visible.

notes.observation: After about a year learning under Periyar, A. S. A. Sami invites Kalaignar to Coimbatore to write dialogue for Jupiter's film 'ராஜகுமாரி'.
